sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: $19.5\ \mathrm{g}$ of fluoro acetic acid (molar mass $=78\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$) is dissolved in $500\ \mathrm{g}$ of water at $298\ \mathrm{K}$. The depression in the freezing point of water was $1\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. What is $K_a$ of fluoro acetic acid ? (For water, $K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$). Assume molarity and molality to have same values.
stem.hi: $19.5\ \mathrm{g}$ फ्लुओरो ऐसीटिक अम्ल (मोलर द्रव्यमान $=78\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$) को $500\ \mathrm{g}$ जल में $298\ \mathrm{K}$ पर घोला गया। जल के हिमांक में अवनमन $1\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ था। फ्लुओरो ऐसीटिक अम्ल का $K_a$ क्या है ? (जल के लिए $K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$)। मान लीजिए कि मोलरता और मोललता के मान समान हैं।

feynman.en: The freezing-point depression is a little more than expected for undissociated acid; the excess gives the van't Hoff factor, hence the degree of ionisation, hence $K_a$.
feynman.hi: हिमांक अवनमन अवियोजित अम्ल से अपेक्षित मान से थोड़ा अधिक है; यह आधिक्य वान्ट हॉफ़ गुणक देता है, उससे आयनन की मात्रा, और उससे $K_a$।
